description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kondadeniya, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy  District - Cad. Map No. 320330
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
